dsneckfix_pdc.configuration.paperDollGli:
Sway the paper-doll dragon while gliding (dive pitch + tail), like the third-person dragon.
Default: true
dsneckfix_pdc.configuration.paperDollAlw:
Always show the paper doll instead of letting it auto-hide.
Default: false
dsneckfix_pdc.configuration.paperDollHum:
Scale the paper-doll dragon to human height, like the other paper dolls.
Default: true
dsneckfix_pdc.configuration.paperDollRid:
Render the full DragonSurvival riding chain in the Fuzs paper doll.
Default: true
dsneckfix_pdc.configuration.dragonDamage:
Show DragonSurvival dragons with the vanilla hurt flash and death fall.
Default: true
